environment.description: Go 1.20 Gin application deployed on EC2 behind a classic ELB (Elastic Load Balancer) with no WAF attached. The ELB performs basic TCP passthrough on port 443. No request inspection or header validation is performed at the infrastructure level. The application runs in a Docker container with net.http server directly handling connections.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 t3.medium, Classic ELB TCP passthrough
config.go_http_server: net/http default (pre-1.21.7, no CRLF protection in Header.Set)
